title: bar / bar.order_placed (v1) data payload
description: A bar/POS order to charge. Published to the 'bar.events' exchange with routing key 'bar.order_placed'; consumed by Billing. 'masterId' is OPTIONAL: when absent the sale is ANONYMOUS (no tab, immediately settled, no PII) per Round 15. Optional masterId is additive/tolerant-reader-safe, so this stays schemaVersion 1.

orderId.description: Client-side id for inbox dedupe of double-taps.

masterId.description: Canonical masterId if the order is against a driver's tab. ABSENT/null = an anonymous immediately-settled sale (no tab, no PII).

unitPrice.description: Price per unit (currency MINOR units (integer cents)).

at.description: When the order was placed (RFC3339 UTC).
